## Summary

Describe the AI feature, prompt, evaluation, or documentation change.

## Reviewer Focus

- [ ] AI behavior is treated as reviewable application behavior.
- [ ] Safety, cost, latency, or evaluation impact is clear when relevant.
- [ ] Tests or docs explain expected behavior around the model.

## Validation

- [ ] Deterministic tests or examples were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Prompt or evaluation changes are documented.
- [ ] Secrets and model credentials remain out of the repository.

## Portfolio Signal

Explain what this PR makes stronger for a technical interview.
